### `pcheey`: R04 preparation/form-II field, with zero dry evidence

There are only three exact occurrences, but all three immediately follow `sho` or `sheo`, and two form a `pcheey-X-daiin` construction. All three are medial in paragraph-opening lines. This repeated bounded-field geometry supports R04 and the neutral reader phrase `gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld`.

The dry frame F03 has zero support. There is also no independent vessel, operation, passage/straining, or closing signal. A previous powder-like reading inherited from the shape of EVA `p` is therefore excluded from the default. Paste, salve, mixed form, or residue after soaking remain possible identities, but none is selected.

1. Zensus und Positionsgeometrie ohne Bedeutung bauen.

4. Fünf Rollen vergleichen: Nomen/Zubereitung, Vorgang, Produkt, Recordfeld,
   Folgen-/Feldverbinder.
5. Nur innerhalb einer tragfähigen Rolle konkrete Identitätskarten werten.
6. Stärksten stützenden locus entfernen und die notwendige Zwei-Achsen-
   Signatur auf einer zweiten Seite erneut prüfen.
